verdict.rationale: Relay's own materials say users can upload bills, automate approvals, and pay vendors. Its pricing page lists multi-step approval rules, and a support article covers setting up payment approvals, so the story's core is a first-party capability. All of this is marketing-level vendor copy, with no hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: detailed docs on bill-upload mechanics (OCR/email-in) and approval routing configuration, plus independent or hands-on corroboration of the bill-approval-pay flow.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can upload bills and route them through an approval workflow before paying vendors

citations.quote: Upload bills, delegate tasks, automate approvals, and pay vendors the way they want to be paid.
How to Set Up Payment Approvals in Relay
